tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and hematuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL Pseudomonas aeruginosa on culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. The presence of glucose and low specific gravity may suggest impaired urine concentration or possible glycosuria. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy guided by sensitivity testing.
